Home
Eat Drink Sleep at the Cliff House
We are an independent restaurant, bar and rooms sitting on the cliff top in Barton on Sea, offering
panoramic views of the Solent.
You can always be certain of a warm welcome and relaxed feel, our team work hard so all you need to do is
sit back and unwind. Whilst we have an informal approach to make everyone feel welcome, we take our food
and service very seriously.
Whether you want to eat, drink or sleep with us, we look forward to your visit.
Opening Hours
Every day 11:30am-11pm
We don't take bookings outside, all tables are first come- first served. To book a table inside our
restaurant, you can book online or give us a call on
01425 619333

Location
With stunning views from our bedrooms, bar and restaurant across to the Isle of Wight and
the Purbecks,
you may not want to leave the Cliff House. For those who want to explore the area though, there is
plenty to do both on our door step and further afield.
On your doorstep
You can wander down to the beach from The Cliff House and find a sheltered spot for a picnic, take a
paddle in the sea or walk along the coastal path to neighbouring villages. Help is always on hand to
suggest the best route for you to take.
Barton on Sea also boasts a Championship Standard golf course which is worth a visit.
Things to do in the area
Grab a rod and enjoy guided fishing or fly fishing lessons in Hampshire & Dorest with Steve Ward www.stevewardfishing.co.uk
Take in the beautiful coastline from a different view point with the New Forest Paddle board
company
Hire a bike and enjoy the stunning routes the New Forest has to offer www.cyclexperience.co.uk/hire-new-forest
Along the coast
All within a 20 minute drive, the villages of Milford on Sea, Highcliffe, Mudeford, Christchurch and
Lymington all have plenty of cafés, restaurants and shops to while away the time. When the sun shines,
many of these spots are also great fun for fishing, crabbing or hiring a small boat. Stretching along
the coast there are numerous beautiful and award winning beaches, Sandbanks is a particular highlight.
Bournemouth town centre is approximately 30 minutes drive and great for shopping or the cinema, with
historic Ports of Southampton and Portsmouth also offering plenty of action with two large outlet
shopping centres.
The New Forest
The New Forest National Park is also just on our door step, with plenty of fun to be had! If you want to
get out and about, there are cycle routes, horse riding trails and some energetic or relaxing walks
whilst taking in the beautiful scenery.
Finding us
If you’re travelling by car, postcode BH25 7QL will bring you straight to our door.
We are just five minutes from New Milton train station by car and will be more than happy to arrange
taxi services between the hotel and station.
